atoms.a: After 13 hours of use, Camille’s phone battery will drop to <mat>14%</mat>, unless she turns on flight mode for a couple of hours. What fraction and decimal represents this percentage?
In the home improvement shop, Manuel bought a pair of rechargeable batteries that last <mat>33.bar(3)%</mat> longer than other batteries. What fractions and decimals represent the percentage.
atoms.sound: In the home improvement shop, Manuel bought a pair of rechargeable batteries that last 33.3recurring% longer than other batteries. What fraction and decimal represents this percentage?

atoms.a: Michelle bought a new car that can drive with electricity and fuel. On her daily commute to work, the car uses <mat>88%</mat> electricity and <mat>12% </mat>fuel. What fraction and decimal represents the percentage of electricity?

Sofía uses her laptop for some schoolwork, which drains the battery to 10%. She plugs it in, and it gains 8% before she leaves to go home. What fraction and decimal represents the percentage of charge on her laptop after charging.

<mat>75%</mat> of the pupils’ favourite sport in year 7 was football. By year 9 this had decreased by <mat>11%</mat>. What fraction and decimal represents the percentage of pupils whose favourite sport is football in year 9.
